fever: Paracetamol 500mg, 1 tablet after food every 6 hours
high fever: Paracetamol 650mg + Cold water sponging every 4 hours
headache: Ibuprofen 400mg, 1 tablet after food as needed
migraine: Naproxen 500mg + Rest in a dark quiet room
wet cough: Ambroxol syrup 10ml thrice daily after food
cold: Cetirizine 10mg, 1 tablet at night before sleeping
blocked nose: Xylometazoline 0.1% nasal drops, 2 drops per nostril twice daily
stomach pain: Dicyclomine 20mg, take 1 tablet when severe pain occurs
stomach cramp: Drotaverine 40mg, 1 tablet as needed after food
acidity: Pantoprazole 40mg, take 1 tablet in morning on empty stomach
indigestion: Digestive enzyme syrup 10ml immediately after heavy meals
body pain: Aceclofenac 100mg, 1 tablet twice daily after food
back pain: Diclofenac gel apply locally + Paracetamol 500mg as needed
neck stiffness: Hot water compress + Ibuprofen 400mg after food
knee pain: Apply Diclofenac spray and rest with knee elevated
diarrhea: ORS hydration mix in 1L water + Zinc 20mg tablet daily
food poisoning: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) + Ciprofloxacin 500mg after doctor advice
throat pain: Warm salt water gargle 3 times a day + Lozenges
sore throat: Betadine gargle solution diluted with warm water twice daily
hoarse voice: Steam inhalation twice daily + Vocal rest
tonsillitis: Amoxicillin 500mg three times daily with doctor confirmation
skin rash: Calamine lotion, apply gently on affected area twice daily
itching: Hydroxyzine 10mg, 1 tablet at night if severe itching
eczema: Hydrocortisone 1% topical cream, apply thin layer twice daily
fungal infection: Clotrimazole 1% dusting powder or cream twice daily
ringworm: Terbinafine 1% cream, apply twice daily for 2 weeks
minor cut: Wash with clean water, apply Povidone-Iodine cream and bandage
deep cut: Clean with antiseptic, apply sterile gauze pressure, get tetanus shot
bleeding wound: Apply direct pressure with clean cloth, elevate injured limb
burn: Silver Sulfadiazine cream, apply thick layer on clean burn area
sunburn: Aloe Vera gel application + Cold water compresses
weakness: Multivitamin with B-Complex, 1 tablet daily after lunch
fatigue: Electrolyte hydration drink + Vitamin D3 weekly capsule
dizziness: ORS solution + Cinnarizine 25mg if motion sickness related
vertigo: Betahistine 16mg, 1 tablet twice daily after meals
low blood pressure: Oral fluids + 1 glass of salt and sugar electrolyte water
constipation: Lactulose syrup 15ml, at bedtime with a glass of water
piles pain: Anovate cream apply locally + High fiber diet
eye irritation: Carboxymethylcellulose lubricating eye drops, 1-2 drops twice daily
red eye: Moxifloxacin 0.5% eye drops, 1 drop 3 times daily
eye strain: Lubricating eye drops + Follow 20-20-20 screen rule
ear pain: Otogesic ear drops, 2 drops in affected ear as needed
ear wax: Wax-dissolving ear drops (Paradichlorobenzene) 3 drops at night
muscle strain: Cold compress for 48 hours then heat pad + Rest
sprain: RICE protocol (Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation) + Ibuprofen 400mg
toothache: Ketorolac DT 10mg, dissolve 1 tablet in half cup of water
bleeding gums: Chlorhexidine 0.2% mouthwash twice daily after brushing
mouth ulcer: Triamcinolone oral paste apply before bedtime + Riboflavin tablets
bad breath: Chlorhexidine mouthwash rinse + Dental hygiene check
anxiety: Deep breathing 4-7-8 exercises + Chamomile tea / Quiet rest
sleeplessness: Melatonin 3mg, 30 minutes before sleep + Avoid screens
asthma attack: Salbutamol inhaler 2 puffs immediately + Emergency evaluation
shortness of breath: Sit upright, check SpO2 with pulse oximeter, seek emergency care
high blood pressure: Amlodipine 5mg morning tablet under physician guidance
palpitations: Rest in sitting posture, drink cool water, ECG evaluation needed
dehydration: ORS 500ml slow sips every 30 minutes until urine turns clear
heat stroke: Move to shade, sponge with cool water, rehydrate, seek immediate care
frostbite: Warm affected area with lukewarm water, do not rub skin
insect bite: Apply ice pack + Calamine lotion + Cetirizine 10mg if swollen
bee sting: Scrape stinger off, apply ice pack, take Levocetirizine 5mg
urinary burning: Disodium hydrogen citrate syrup 2 spoons in glass of water
urinary infection: Nitrofurantoin 100mg twice daily with medical prescription
chills: Keep warm with blankets + Paracetamol 500mg if accompanied by fever
hiccups: Drink glass of cold water quickly or swallow teaspoon of sugar
acne: Benzoyl peroxide 2.5% gel, apply small dot at night on clean skin
